soundness_flags.label: def:sequential-certificate and thm:promised-transcript-certificate
soundness_flags.one_line: The procedure says to take N_r further observations and invert S_{m,r}, but neither specifies cumulative versus fresh covariances nor delays inversion until N_r is at least the common-support dimension, so early-stage operations and the advertised per-environment budget are undefined.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:promised-transcript-certificate / ass:reached-eigen-band / ass:reached-projector-band
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: Recovery is conditional on public transcript-local spectral and projector gaps, rather than claiming those gaps are necessary for all CRL procedures.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Finite-sample recovery and abstention guarantee only for P in P_A(g_0,h_0,kappa).

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:strict-margin-improvement
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The strict improvement is only a sufficient-condition comparison for the fixed public transcript, not a minimax lower-bound or universal necessity claim.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: Strict relaxation of Acartürk et al.'s all-subset sufficient margin on the stated linear-Gaussian perfect-intervention subclass.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 7, equation (22); appendix p. 20, Lemma 13 and equations (110)–(128)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines eta-star as the minimum nonzero eigenvalue over sums R_X^M for M subseteq [n], and Lemma 13 transfers approximate ranks for every subset using that global quantity.
The paper gives score-based CRL algorithms, treats linear transformations, and states that one stochastic hard intervention per node suffices for linear-transform identifiability.

source_verification_receipts.locator: abstract and bibliographic record, lines 23–25 and 36–38
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The proceedings version studies a linear transformation of a linear latent causal model and states that a single intervention on each latent variable is sufficient for identifiability.
The paper supplies time-uniform nonasymptotic confidence-sequence machinery, including matrix martingales and a covariance-estimation application.
The proceedings paper identifies deterministic spectral-gap and spectral-projector subroutines; its full-version Corollary 4.5 concerns invariant-subspace projectors.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define S_{m,r} as a cumulative covariance from exactly N_r total post-support draws, start spectral testing at r_0=ceil(log2 n), and recalculate B_samp against the total cumulative draw convention.

State and prove a generic-class version of the strict-margin comparison that quantifies the full reached-gap class and its strict inclusion over the published all-subset class, beyond the single witness family.
Resolve the rational interval handle into a polynomial-bit theorem, including a composed projector-product norm enclosure and a formal total-cost bound.

recommended_next_step: Repair the sequential sampling/inversion specification and budget, then advance the field-level transcript-local margin kernel to Stage 0.
